context_for_next_agent: Two sessions of work are on this branch. The first closed the codebase-review-20261026 plan (30/30 tasks, commits 912717e through 0b69a38). The second ran a review/correct/deslop pass over that work and closed 4 more findings (9229246, 95c6a9e, 51d4db6, c04f5b8). Read project-log-md/claude_code/session-summary-20261029-1721.md first; its predecessor session-summary-20261029-1132.md has the per-task detail for the 30-task plan. Every task followed the same loop: failing test first, implement, push, wait for a GREEN CI SHA before moving on. CI is the only trustworthy judge — the Windows local env gives false results (full backend suite hangs near the end; run vitest as `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run <path>` because npm does not create node_modules/.bin). THREE LESSONS THAT COST EXTRA ROUNDS THIS SESSION: (1) a green E2E job with retries hides real races — grep the run log for 'retry #1' before believing a conclusion, because 95c6a9e passed only on retry while carrying a genuine paint race; (2) waiting for a network response is not waiting for React to paint — e2e waits must target the rendered element, and a `.or()` union needs `.first()` on the combined locator or strict mode throws when both branches match; (3) when the isolation worktree option is used, verify the checkout is on the branch under review — here it silently based reviewers on main at an older commit and two adversaries caught it themselves. Turbopack build flakes with "Can't resolve @vercel/turbopack-next/internal/font/google/font" while fetching Outfit from fonts.gstatic.com; it hit three times and cleared on re-run each time, so never treat it as a code regression. Deferred and still open: the three cd.yml soft-skip paths above; ruff gate scope excludes backend/scripts (25 pre-existing errors); E501/E402 cleanup; mypy evaluation; KEY_MANAGE_RICH_MENUS/KEY_MANAGE_REPLY_OBJECTS gate reads and writes with one key; and a pre-existing tsc error at e2e/admin-audit-verify/nav-search-roles.spec.ts:53.
